title: $K$-holomorphic functions with definable real part
summary: Let $R$ be a real closed field and $K:=R(i)$ its algebraic closure. Let $U\subset K^n$ be an open and definable set in a fixed o-minimal structure. In this note, we study the relationship between definability of a $K$-holomorphic function $f=f_1+if_2:U\to K$ and the definability and (strong) $R$-analyticity of its real part $f_1:U\to R$. Our results turn out to be the best possible {in general}, and their precision depends on the considered o-minimal structure. We obtain a complete characterisation in the semialgebraic case.
